title: The best commerce transaction of the next decade is the one no one had to initiate
description: Think about the last time you manually reordered office supplies, triggered a price adjustment or initiated a cross-border inventory transfer. If your answer is \"recently, and it took multiple systems and several people,\" that's exactly the problem.

title: The Silent Cost of Knowledge Loss in Growing Organizations
description: Growth is often interpreted as a clear indicator of organizational success. Expanding teams, increasing project velocity and a growing customer base all signal forward momentum. However, beneath this visible progress lies a less obvious but deeply consequential challenge one that rarely appears in performance dashboards yet significantly impacts execution.
